methodology: Fresh independent canister per implementation/case/trial; identical Nat payloads and result checksums. Input setup and 4 explicit GC increments outside measurement. Raw performanceCounter(0) plus allocation/reclaimed deltas include loop/dispatch/counter overhead but exclude reply encoding and end-of-message GC. Core Queue 2.6.2 implements sequence lookup/page by cursor traversal. Post-call memory sampled after 4 explicit GC increments; heap is current managed heap, memory is Wasm high-water, maxLive is historical high-water. Churn uses unique 1KiB Blobs in 16 batches of 1024, capacity1024, validates all retained bytes, forces 8 GC increments per checkpoint, then clears and repeats GC. Distinct allocation and retained heap are never conflated.
